summary: Teramind DLP is data loss prevention by an agent on employee computers, combined with activity recording and behavior analytics: it finds sensitive data and keeps it from being sent out unnoticed.
value: An attempt to send personal data, card data or trade secrets by email, web upload, cloud or an AI service can be blocked by a rule or logged.
The employee immediately sees which rule they broke.
A change in an employee’s behavior shows up in the risk score, giving a reason to check them earlier.
Recordings and logs support investigations and evidence in case of deliberate data theft.
simple: The Teramind agent on the computer combines user activity recording with DLP. It recognizes sensitive data with ready-made and custom patterns (PII, PHI, PCI; per the vendor, more than 200 pre-packaged rules), classifies documents by content and metadata, applies tags and fingerprints (Fingerprinting and tagging), redacts sensitive content (Redaction) and enforces content-based and file-operation rules. It controls email and attachments, web uploads, cloud transfers, the clipboard and work with AI services: conversation recording, LLM content rules for prompts, pasting sensitive data and uploading files to chatbots; the vendor’s Insider Risk Management page also lists USB and printing among the channels. On a violation: an alert, a warning to the user, automatic blocking of the action or session termination. Behavior analytics spots anomalies and calculates a risk score for each user; there is screen recording, a log of keystrokes, console commands and printing, full-text search and event forwarding to a SIEM. Separately, In-app fraud detection. Deployment: Teramind cloud, own data center or a private cloud in AWS or Azure; licensed per user. Compared with Enterprise & Government, it lacks OCR, field capture in websites and applications, and professional services. Recording employees’ activity, keystrokes, audio, camera and geolocation requires a legal basis and notice to employees (GDPR, labor law): the scope of collection is configured to company policy, and recording only on rule violations reduces it.
notIncluded: No text recognition on screen and in images (OCR): it is only in Enterprise & Government.
No form field capture in websites and applications (Custom website / app field capture): only in Enterprise & Government.
Hosting in AWS GovCloud and Azure Government, and rule and integration setup by the vendor, are only in Enterprise & Government.
classification: The Data Loss Prevention section of the table (content-based and file-operation rules, classification, fingerprinting, “Prevent malicious or negligent data exfiltration”) and the clipboard are DLP, the main class.
Anomalies and risk scoring are UEBA, as in UAM.

Control of USB drives and devices (allowing or blocking the devices themselves) is not named in the table; USB on the Insider Risk page is a leak channel within DLP, so no device control; In-app fraud detection, screen recording and Remote control are text only.
